description: Improve code quality, readability, and maintainability without changing external behavior.
rules: Run tests before and after each step
Keep git history clean — one refactor per commit
Do not mix refactoring with feature additions
Prefer extracting named functions over inline code
Ensure TypeScript types remain strict after refactor
safetyNotes: Require explicit permission for multi-file refactors
Never rename exports without checking all import sites
Verify TypeScript compiles after each step
